svg.title: The 90/5/5 Capital Stack
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-sba-seller-note-capital-stack; chapter number: 6; title: The 90/5/5 Capital Stack; subtitle: How the purchase price narrows to the buyer's own cash; chart type: funnel; stages: label: Purchase Price; value: 100; display: 100% of price; conversion: Baseline; detail: The full price the capital stack has to cover.; label: SBA 7(a) Loan; value: 90; display: 90% of price; conversion: 90% financed by the SBA loan; detail: Keira Hamilton calls the 90% SBA loan the base of the most common structure.; label: Required Equity Injection; value: 10; display: 10% of price; conversion: 10% injection on a change of ownership; detail: The 10% injection on an initial acquisition cannot be reduced.; label: Seller Note on Full Standby; value: 5; display: 5% of price; conversion: No more than 50% of the required injection; detail: Counts toward equity only on full standby for the life of the loan; never call it a 10-year note (JackQuisitions).; label: Buyer Cash; value: 5; display: 5% of price; conversion: Remaining half of the injection; detail: The buyer's own cash; a full 10% seller note shows up mostly for insiders or deep industry operators.; caption: The street baseline of a 90% SBA loan, 5% buyer cash and a 5% seller note, with the seller note capped at half of the required injection.; assumptions note: Values are percentages of purchase price as testified; combined SBA and seller note payments must still clear 1.25x debt service coverage (Josh Kim).; note: Attributed to Keira Hamilton (7RAyVC1b9Pg at 00:01:27), Allan Peterson on JackQuisitions (I6M8wAaqm5s at 00:22:18), Loan To Launch (OSZgayF9jHw at 00:03:06) and Josh Kim (W3nhTnkKZcU at 00:04:29).

circle.title: label: Purchase Price; value: 100; display: 100% of price; conversion: Baseline; detail: The full price the capital stack has to cover.
label: SBA 7(a) Loan; value: 90; display: 90% of price; conversion: 90% financed by the SBA loan; detail: Keira Hamilton calls the 90% SBA loan the base of the most common structure.
label: Required Equity Injection; value: 10; display: 10% of price; conversion: 10% injection on a change of ownership; detail: The 10% injection on an initial acquisition cannot be reduced.

label: Seller Note on Full Standby; value: 5; display: 5% of price; conversion: No more than 50% of the required injection; detail: Counts toward equity only on full standby for the life of the loan; never call it a 10-year note (JackQuisitions).

label: Buyer Cash; value: 5; display: 5% of price; conversion: Remaining half of the injection; detail: The buyer's own cash; a full 10% seller note shows up mostly for insiders or deep industry operators.

text.title: Assumptions: Values are percentages of purchase price as testified; combined SBA and seller note payments must still clear 1.25x debt service coverage (Josh Kim).
text.tspan: Assumptions: Values are percentages of purchase price as testified; combined SBA and seller note payments must still clear 1.25x debt
